title: Register your new MFA device before you're locked out
scenario: An email says your MFA method is being upgraded and you must register a new device within the hour through the linked form, or lose access to your account today.

answers.A: Go directly to your company's identity portal to check and manage MFA settings instead of the link.
answers.B: Register through the link quickly to avoid losing access.
answers.C: Register through the link, and also share the current MFA code to 'transfer' it.

explanation: A real MFA change is managed inside your company's own identity system, not through a countdown email that hands you a new device-registration link.
proTip: MFA changes happen in the identity portal you already use, never in a link that emailed you.
